# hudu_asset_layout (Resource)

Manages a Hudu Asset Layout. Note: the Hudu API has no DELETE endpoint for layouts; `terraform destroy` deactivates the layout (sets `active = false`) and removes it from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hudu_asset_layout" "computer" {
  name              = "Computer Assets"
  icon              = "fas fa-laptop"
  color             = "#1f77b4"
  icon_color        = "#ffffff"
  include_passwords = true
  include_photos    = true
  include_comments  = true
  include_files     = true

  fields = [
    {
      label        = "Operating System"
      field_type   = "Text"
      position     = 1
      required     = true
      show_in_list = true
    },
    {
      label      = "Serial Number"
      field_type = "Text"
      position   = 2
    },
    {
      label      = "Purchase Date"
      field_type = "Date"
      position   = 3
      expiration = false
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Asset layout name.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the layout is active. Setting to false hides it from the UI but does not delete it.
- `color` (String) Background color as a hex string.
- `fields` (Attributes List) Custom fields. Order in HCL is preserved; matching against the API is by list position so reordering will be treated as updates rather than re-creates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `icon` (String) Font Awesome icon class, e.g. `fas fa-laptop`.
- `icon_color` (String) Icon color as a hex string.
- `include_comments` (Boolean) Whether assets using this layout include a comments section.
- `include_files` (Boolean) Whether assets using this layout include a files section.
- `include_passwords` (Boolean) Whether assets using this layout include a passwords section.
- `include_photos` (Boolean) Whether assets using this layout include a photos section.
- `password_types` (String) Newline-separated list of password types.
- `sidebar_folder_id` (Number) ID of the sidebar folder this layout is grouped under in the Hudu sidebar. The folder must already exist in Hudu — the API has no endpoint to create sidebar folders, so create the folder in the Hudu UI and reference its numeric ID here.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp the layout was created, in ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. `2026-01-15T12:34:56.789Z`).
- `id` (String) Numeric ID assigned by Hudu, as a string.
- `slug` (String) URL slug generated by Hudu.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp the layout was last updated, in ISO 8601 UTC.

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Required:

- `field_type` (String) One of: Text, RichText, Heading, CheckBox, Website, Password, Email, Phone, Number, Date, Dropdown, Embed, Address, AssetTag, ListSelect, etc.
- `label` (String) Field label shown in the Hudu UI. Also determines the snake_case key used for this field in `hudu_asset.custom_fields`.
- `position` (Number) 1-based position of the field within the layout.

Optional:

- `expiration` (Boolean) Whether values in this field feed Hudu expiration tracking (Date fields).
- `hint` (String) Help text shown beneath the field in the Hudu UI.
- `linkable_id` (Number) Asset layout ID to pull values from (AssetTag fields).
- `list_id` (Number) List ID to pull values from (ListSelect fields).
- `max` (Number) Maximum accepted value (Number fields).
- `min` (Number) Minimum accepted value (Number fields).
- `multiple_options` (Boolean) Whether more than one option may be selected (Dropdown and ListSelect fields).
- `options` (String) Newline-separated list of dropdown options.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the field must be filled in.
- `show_in_list` (Boolean) Whether the field is shown in asset list views.

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Numeric field ID assigned by Hudu.
